crossRefs.note: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has…
Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne…
He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things…
God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings…
When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and…
When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”
Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the…
The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man…
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

translations.web: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”
translations.bsb: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, “Come!”
translations.kjv: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
translations.asv: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying as with a voice of thunder, Come.
